task: Bounded primary-source scout on finite-sample hidden-state thermodynamic inference

sources.citation: Jannik Ehrich, Tightest bound on hidden entropy production from partially observed dynamics, arXiv:2105.08803v2, 2021-07-05; J. Stat. Mech. 083214 (2021).
sources.read_depth: Full PDF downloaded; reconstructed stationary masking/path-KL calculation and four-state hidden-realization inverse algebra.
decisive_spans: PDF printed pp. 3-4, Eq. (3), setup: finite stationary Markov chain, steady state, reversible support.
PDF printed pp. 6-7, Eq. (6)-(12): full EP as path time-reversal KL rate; memoryless masking and data processing.
PDF printed pp. 8-9, Eq. (23)-(24): observed waiting-time/jump-statistic KL formula and finite-lag truncation remains a population lower bound.
PDF printed pp. 9-10, Eq. (28)-(29): hidden realization P(n)=C H^(n-2) B.
PDF printed pp. 12-14, Eq. (39)-(48): known two-hidden-state example inversion, nonsingularity assumption, free parameters, numerical minimization, general nonlinear inverse gap.
PDF printed pp. 14-16, Fig. 8-10 and Discussion: potentially unbounded compatible high EP and best-case exact-statistics assumption.
sources.claim_status: source-reported; decisive formulas independently reconstructed at the stated scope
limitations: No finite-sample coverage or anytime-valid interval.
The concrete realization fit assumes correct hidden-state count and exact/high-accuracy observable statistics.
General higher-dimensional inverse problem left as nonlinear equations with possibly many free parameters.

sources.citation: Jonas H. Fritz, Benjamin Ertel, and Udo Seifert, Entropy estimation for partially accessible Markov networks based on imperfect observations: Role of finite resolution and finite statistics, arXiv:2412.04102v2, 2025-04-08; Phys. Rev. E 111, 044106 (2025-04-07).
sources.read_depth: Full PDF downloaded; read and reconstructed Sec. II-III, Eq. (1)-(19), including finite-statistics overshoot statement.
decisive_spans: PDF pp. 1-2, Eq. (1)-(8): true stationary EP and population lower estimators.
PDF p. 4, Eq. (10): log-sum inequality produces a population-level finite-resolution lower estimator.
PDF pp. 4-5, Sec. III, Eq. (16)-(19): finite-T empirical waiting-time histograms and estimator fluctuations.
PDF p. 5, lines around 533-546 in extracted full text: finite T and finite replicate count can make the empirical average exceed the population waiting-time bound and true EP.
limitations: Finite-statistics treatment is model-specific simulation/variance characterization, not uniform one-sided coverage.
Does not prove impossibility of valid finite-sample EP inference.

sources.citation: Daniel Hsu, Sham M. Kakade, and Tong Zhang, A Spectral Algorithm for Learning Hidden Markov Models, arXiv:0811.4413v6, 2012-07-06; J. Comput. Syst. Sci. 78 (2012), 1460-1480.
sources.read_depth: Full PDF downloaded; read rank/invertibility assumptions, Lemmas 1-4, Theorem 6, and the relevant proof section.
decisive_spans: PDF pp. 3-4, Condition 1: strictly positive initial hidden-state distribution and full-rank observation and transition matrices.
PDF pp. 5-7, Lemmas 1-4 and proofs: observable operator representation and finite observation-word probabilities.

PDF p. 10, Theorem 6: high-probability L1 error epsilon for joint length-t observation distributions from N independent sequences, with sample complexity depending polynomially on inverse singular values.
PDF pp. 15-18, Proof of Theorem 6: propagation of estimated operator errors.
PDF p. 4, lines 159-171: independent-sequence assumption used for sample analysis; single dependent trajectory needs mixing-aware concentration not proved here.
sources.claim_status: source-reported; relevant assumptions and theorem interface extracted
limitations: The learned operator model is not a recovered physical transition-rate matrix, and no EP functional is bounded.
TV/L1 control alone does not control KL near zero-probability events without additional support assumptions.
The theorem assumes a known model rank and independent sequences, not a single arbitrary dependent path.

not_done: No external novelty or priority claim.
No theorem proving a finite-sample or anytime EP lower confidence bound.
No independent numerical experiment or implementation.
